title: SonarQube Cloud project analyzes read-only Framework and MRTS trees
title_de: SonarQube-Cloud-Projekt analysiert schreibgeschützte Framework- und MRTS-Bäume
summary: The current Parent SonarQube Cloud project includes 341 Framework-exclusive and 17 MRTS issue records even though those nested repositories are read-only and outside this task's ownership boundary.
summary_de: Das aktuelle Parent-SonarQube-Cloud-Projekt enthält 341 ausschließlich zum Framework gehörende und 17 MRTS-Issue-Records, obwohl diese verschachtelten Repositories schreibgeschützt und außerhalb der Ownership-Grenze dieser Aufgabe liegen.
observed_behavior: The retained, paginated baseline for remote Parent SHA aabde81a9a315bf3e494e595ab0399357c596f9c contains 358 records beneath modules/ModSecurity-test-Framework/: 337 open and 4 closed Framework-exclusive records, plus 17 open MRTS-subtree records. Public effective settings confirm sonar.autoscan.enabled=true, while the Parent has no versioned scanner configuration; no Parent-owned fix can remediate those nested-source records.
observed_behavior_de: Die zurückgehaltene, paginierte Baseline für Remote-Parent-SHA aabde81a9a315bf3e494e595ab0399357c596f9c enthält 358 Records unterhalb von modules/ModSecurity-test-Framework/: 337 offene und 4 geschlossene ausschließlich zum Framework gehörende Records sowie 17 offene Records im MRTS-Subtree. Öffentliche effektive Settings bestätigen sonar.autoscan.enabled=true, während der Parent keine versionierte Scanner-Konfiguration besitzt; kein Parent-eigener Fix kann diese Nested-Source-Records beheben.
expected_behavior: A Parent Sonar analysis must report only Parent-owned source paths. Framework and MRTS paths must have zero analyzed issue records without suppressing, disabling, or broadly excluding Parent source rules.
expected_behavior_de: Eine Parent-Sonar-Analyse muss ausschließlich Parent-eigene Source-Pfade ausweisen. Framework- und MRTS-Pfade müssen null analysierte Issue-Records haben, ohne Parent-Source-Regeln zu unterdrücken, zu deaktivieren oder breit auszuschließen.
impact: The current analysis cannot be reconciled entirely through authorized Parent source changes, and nested security/quality records can distort project-wide metrics and gate triage.
impact_de: Die aktuelle Analyse kann nicht vollständig durch autorisierte Parent-Source-Änderungen abgeglichen werden; verschachtelte Security-/Quality-Records können projektweite Metriken und die Gate-Triage verfälschen.
preconditions: The SonarQube Cloud project analyzes the Parent checkout with Automatic Analysis enabled.
Framework and MRTS remain independent read-only repository boundaries for this task.
reproduction: Use the retained issue baseline and count components beginning with Easton97-Jens_ModSecurity-conector:modules/ModSecurity-test-Framework/ and its /tools/MRTS/ subtree.
Read the public effective project settings for Easton97-Jens_ModSecurity-conector and confirm sonar.autoscan.enabled=true.

evidence.command: RTK-proxied public SonarQube Cloud V1 issue pagination followed by component-prefix accounting for the retained baseline
RTK-proxied public SonarQube Cloud V1 exact-current issue pagination followed by component-prefix accounting for the retained baseline

root_cause: Confirmed scope contamination: the current SonarQube Cloud project analyzes nested Framework and MRTS paths. The public effective setting sonar.autoscan.enabled=true and the absence of Parent scanner configuration support Automatic Analysis as the active mechanism, but administrative project-scope configuration is not available in this task environment.
root_cause_de: Bestätigte Scope-Kontamination: Das aktuelle SonarQube-Cloud-Projekt analysiert verschachtelte Framework- und MRTS-Pfade. Das öffentliche effektive Setting sonar.autoscan.enabled=true und das Fehlen einer Parent-Scanner-Konfiguration stützen Automatic Analysis als aktiven Mechanismus, aber administrative Projekt-Scope-Konfiguration steht in dieser Aufgabenumgebung nicht zur Verfügung.
proposed_remediation: An authorized SonarQube Cloud project administrator must configure a narrow ownership boundary that excludes only the nested Framework and MRTS repository trees, or migrate the project to a CI-managed scanner with an explicit Parent-only source scope. Re-run the analysis and prove that Parent sources remain covered and Framework/MRTS paths are absent. Do not suppress rules, add NOSONAR, or use a broad Parent-source exclusion.
proposed_remediation_de: Ein autorisierter SonarQube-Cloud-Projektadministrator muss eine enge Ownership-Grenze konfigurieren, die ausschließlich die verschachtelten Framework- und MRTS-Repository-Bäume ausschließt, oder das Projekt auf einen CI-gesteuerten Scanner mit explizitem Parent-only-Source-Scope migrieren. Die Analyse ist erneut auszuführen und muss belegen, dass Parent-Source weiterhin erfasst wird und Framework-/MRTS-Pfade fehlen. Regeln dürfen nicht unterdrückt, NOSONAR nicht hinzugefügt und Parent-Source nicht breit ausgeschlossen werden.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh SHA-bound SonarQube Cloud analysis reports zero components or issue records under modules/ModSecurity-test-Framework/ and its tools/MRTS subtree.
The analysis still includes the intended Parent source paths and preserves all Parent rules and quality-gate controls.
The configuration change and exact resulting analysis revision are retained without secrets.
validation_plan: Query paginated issues for the exact post-change analysis and assert zero nested Framework/MRTS component paths.
Compare Parent component counts and quality-gate conditions before and after the scope correction.
Review the effective scope configuration for absence of NOSONAR, rule disabling, or broad Parent-source exclusions.
regression_tests: A scope-accounting readback must fail if a nested Framework or MRTS component reappears.
legitimate_control_tests: A representative Parent source component remains present in the post-change analysis.
dependencies: SonarQube Cloud project-administration access or an approved CI-scanner migration decision
blocked_by: No SonarQube Cloud project-administration credential or approved external-configuration authority is available in this task environment.
residual_risk: Current project-wide quality and security counts include findings that this Parent-only task is forbidden to modify. No user risk acceptance has been given.
residual_risk_de: Aktuelle projektweite Quality- und Security-Zählungen enthalten Findings, die diese Parent-only-Aufgabe nicht ändern darf. Es liegt keine Risikoakzeptanz durch den Benutzer vor.

history.detail: Allocated after deduplicating against FND-SONAR-0001: this is a distinct, independently remediable project-scope configuration defect; no nested source or project setting was changed.

Superseding remote Parent SHA aabde81a9a315bf3e494e595ab0399357c596f9c retains the exact same nested-scope accounting: 337 open and 4 closed Framework-exclusive records plus 17 open MRTS-subtree records. No nested source, project setting, suppression, rule, or risk-acceptance mutation was performed; the authorized external scope correction remains blocked.
